What
A readability pass over every USA v1.01 C unit (src/core, src/game, src/levels, 3,500+ files, about 8,150 functions):

Function comments: a short plain-English comment above each function saying what it does in the game. Existing matching notes are kept unchanged.
Local names: decompiler-style locals and parameters (s0, arg0, temp_v0, var_a1, ...) and unkXX fields of file-local structs are renamed to meaningful names (moby, vars, pathPoint, ...).

commits.headline: docs(src): readable names, simple comments and moby labels for USA v1.01 (#464)
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
Every USA v1.01 C unit (src/core, src/game, src/levels):
- a short plain-English comment above each function saying what it does;
- decompiler-style locals and parameters (s0, arg0, temp_v0, var_a1, ...)
  and unkXX fields of file-local structs renamed to meaningful names;
- moby class ids in code labelled from docs/game/moby-dispatch.tsv, e.g.
  `0x1366 /* Miniturret */`, or `/* moby class N */` when unlabelled.

commits.headline: refactor(names): readable names like rac1-decomp, snake_case, in definitions too
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
Carry rac1-decomp's naming scheme (docs/contributing/names.md, style.md):
- config/names.tsv is the table (symbol, name, tier, source, evidence,
  alternatives); config/names_local.tsv holds names given from reading the
  code; tools/names.py (local, header, apply-defs, apply, check, rename,
  lookup) generates include/names.h and include/names/*.h, one part per
  level plus executable.h and shared_levels.h.
- Definitions, bodies, extern lines and prototypes use the readable name;…

commits.headline: refactor(src): snake_case locals and MOBY_CLASS_* names for moby class ids
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
- The camelCase locals, parameters and file-local struct fields PR #464
  introduced are respelled snake_case (pathPoint -> path_point), as
  rac1-decomp's style asks: 6,043 names in 1,091 files. Only names whose
  every use in the file came from PR #464 were changed, and none that would
  clash with a readable name, a header identifier or another name in the file.

commits.headline: fix(src): agree on return types between definitions and declarations
commits.author: Lynder063
commits.body:
Each file matched retail on its own, but 989 functions had a definition and
callers' declarations with different return type classes (void, int32,
int64, int128, float, double, pointer). A tool that links all the C together
(OpenRAC's hostgen) read the wrong register: snd_compute_voice_volume_from_distance
(func_002E46C0) was defined float while its callers read an int, and weapon
fire and every 3D sound with a distance went silent.
